agent_discovery.description: Build a review-only tool control-frame candidate from VLM-selected image landmarks, flexible-grid RGB-D registration, and the observed robot tool pose. This Skill handles reflective tools by selecting nearby valid depth with explicit per-landmark policy and provenance.
when_to_use: A mounted tool needs an acting point or controlled frame relative to the robot tool frame.
A shiny blade or tool surface requires nearby valid depth instead of trusting the exact highlighted pixel.
A tool registration needs VLM, RGB-D, calibration, and robot-pose provenance in one finite result.
when_not_to_use: The candidate would be used for motion without operator review and controller safety checks.
The tool is moving relative to the gripper during observation.
The requested landmarks do not define the intended control-frame orientation.
side_effects: Reads camera and timestamped transform observations.
May call an explicitly selected VLM backend.
Returns a review-only candidate and does not publish or activate a control frame.

tool_description.description: Tool and relevant landmarks to identify.

control_frame_purpose.description: Meaning of the desired acting point and axes.

target_frame.description: Calibrated stationary workcell frame for registration.
